title: Family Group Portrait Outside House, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1940s black and white vintage snapshot showing a family of six gathered together near the front porch of a classic American residential home. The attire features classic mid-20th-century fashion including a wide patterned tie, a double-breasted jacket, high-waisted skirts, and traditional hairstyles of the WWII era. Noticeable lens flare or overexposure appears at the top left portion of the image.
